description: A director of people operations must finalize the participation plan for a cross-team retreat intended to improve trust after a merger, including the schedule, facilitation, breakout boundaries, and follow-up commitments.

shared_context.S1: The recently merged Customer Insights and Operations teams are scheduled for a trust-building retreat next month.
shared_context.S2: The current draft describes a full-day in-person event with team discussions, paired exercises, and a manager-led reflection.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the final retreat format and participation safeguards.
shared_context.S4: As a routine step before employee events, Mara conducts a round-robin consultation with participating team members and HR before approving the plan.

PF1.text: Imani has an approved caregiving arrangement that allows her to participate only remotely from 13:00 through 16:00 on the retreat date; the arrangement is recorded in her local manager's file but was not attached to the event request.

PF2.text: Leo personally observed exactly two earlier team sessions in which Alex, the Operations manager, publicly interrupted Sam during disagreements; Leo believes the retreat should record exactly two prior incidents and prohibit supervisor-employee pairings in the exercises, but he has not filed an incident summary.

PF3.text: Ruth confirmed yesterday that the company's trust-building event procedure requires written opt-in before any conflict-repair exercise, a neutral facilitator, and exactly two follow-up check-ins; the procedure memo has not yet been attached to Mara's event packet.

acceptance_conditions: The retreat must be hybrid so Imani can participate remotely.
The retreat must run exactly from 13:00 through 16:00.
The record must contain exactly two observed prior incidents.
Supervisor-employee pairings must be prohibited in the exercises.
A neutral facilitator must lead the retreat.
Written opt-in must be required before the conflict-repair exercise.
Exactly two follow-up check-ins must be scheduled.
The plan must include commitments to document the incident record and schedule the follow-ups.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Imani's approved arrangement changes the retreat from the drafted in-person full-day event to a hybrid event running exactly from 13:00 through 16:00.
Leo's two firsthand observations change the incident record to exactly 2, prohibit supervisor-employee pairings, and require a commitment to document those incidents.
Ruth's confirmed procedure changes the retreat plan to a neutral facilitator, written opt-in, and exactly 2 follow-up check-ins with a follow-up commitment.
